channel.title: New York City Scream
channel.description: New York City Scream: latest stories

item.title: Holiday Season Arrives: The 100th Macy's Parade, the Tree and the Rockettes
item.description: The Rockefeller Center tree arrives Nov. 7, the Christmas Spectacular is underway at Radio City, and Macy's marches for the 100th time on Thanksgiving morning.

item.title: New York Today and Tonight: Wonderful Life, Charles Lloyd, Karan Aujla
item.description: Best picks today: a 1 PM Mozart and Martines concert at Trinity Church, a 5 PM Godspell at LaGuardia, and Broadway's opening-night It's a Wonderful Life.

item.title: It's a Wonderful Life: A Live Radio Play Opens at the Broadhurst
item.description: Opening night is Wednesday, November 18 at the Broadhurst Theatre, with a limited holiday run through January 3, 2027.

item.title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone in Concert With the New York Philharmonic
item.description: Sunday, December 20 at 2 PM at David Geffen Hall, Lincoln Center, with the orchestra performing the John Williams score live.

item.title: The New York Pops Brings Denée Benton and Jordan Donica to Carnegie Hall
item.description: Steven Reineke conducts One Night Only on Friday, November 20 at 8:00 PM at Carnegie Hall's Stern Auditorium in Midtown.

item.title: LaGuardia Students Stage Godspell at the Little Theater in Long Island City
item.description: LaGuardia Community College's theatre program presents Godspell, November 18 through 22, at the Little Theater in Long Island City.

item.title: Architects of Liberation at MoMA: Modernism in Western Africa
item.description: On view on the third floor of MoMA's Robert B. Menschel Galleries through January 2, 2027, with about 400 objects from seven countries.

item.title: Handel's Messiah Returns to Carnegie Hall With the Oratorio Society
item.description: Monday, December 21 at 7 p.m. in Stern Auditorium at Carnegie Hall in Midtown, with soloists Jen Zetlan, Daniel Moody, Brian Giebler and Jonathan Woody.

item.title: Broadway Magic Hour Brings a Family Magic Matinee on November 21
item.description: Saturday, November 21 from 2 to 3 p.m., with Jim Vines and Carl Mercurio, a one-hour family show currently listed as sold out.

item.title: Kevin Puts's Bassoon Concerto Gets Its World Premiere at Geffen Hall
item.description: Santtu-Matias Rouvali leads the New York Philharmonic at the Wu Tsai Theater on Nov. 25, 27 and 28 and Dec. 1 at 7:30 p.m., with bassoonist Judith LeClair.

item.title: Jeannette Sorrell Conducts Handel's Messiah at David Geffen Hall
item.description: Four performances from Wednesday, Dec. 9 to Sunday, Dec. 13 in the Wu Tsai Theater at Lincoln Center, with Apollo's Singers and four soloists.

item.title: The Vanguard Jazz Orchestra Brings Big-Band Jazz to Trinity Church
item.description: Sunday, Nov. 22 at 4 p.m. at Trinity Church on Broadway, part of the Jazz Icons series. The concert is sold out but can be watched online.

item.title: Paul Taylor Dance Company Brings Three Premieres to Lincoln Center
item.description: Runs November 3 to 22 at the David H. Koch Theater, Lincoln Center, Upper West Side, with showtimes listed at boxoffice.dance.

item.title: Saint-Saëns's Samson et Dalila Comes to the Met on December 18
item.description: Friday, December 18 at 7 p.m. at the Metropolitan Opera House, Lincoln Center, Upper West Side; check metopera.org for casting.

item.title: Trinity Choir Pairs Marianna Martines With Mozart at Trinity Church
item.description: Wednesday, November 18 from 1 to 2 p.m. at Trinity Church, 89 Broadway, Lower Manhattan, in the Concerts at One series.

item.title: Sandbox Percussion Brings Steve Reich's Drumming to Trinity Church
item.description: Thursday, November 19 at 6:30 p.m. at Trinity Church, 89 Broadway, Lower Manhattan, with Sandbox Percussion and the students they have mentored.

item.title: NYBG's Holiday Train Show Runs Through January 10 in the Bronx
item.description: Opens Saturday, November 14, with timed entry from 10 a.m., at the Enid A. Haupt Conservatory, New York Botanical Garden, Bronx.

item.title: Frank Huang Plays Mendelssohn With the New York Philharmonic
item.description: Thursday, November 19 at 7:30 PM at David Geffen Hall in Lincoln Center, with further concerts on November 20 and 21.

item.title: Harlem Gospel Choir Sings at the Blue Note on Sunday, November 22
item.description: Sunday, November 22 at 1:30 PM at the Blue Note jazz club in Greenwich Village.

item.title: Sitarist Rishab Rikhiram Sharma Plays Carnegie Hall on November 21
item.description: Saturday, November 21 at Stern Auditorium in Carnegie Hall, Midtown.

item.title: MasterVoices Celebrates Handel at Carnegie Hall on December 15
item.description: Tuesday, Dec. 15 at 7:30 p.m. in Carnegie Hall's Stern Auditorium in Midtown, Ted Sperling leads the MasterVoices Chorus and New York Baroque in a Handel holiday celebration.

item.title: Raúl Esparza Stars in Galileo, a New Broadway Musical at the Shubert Theatre
item.description: Previews begin Tuesday, Nov. 10, and the show opens Sunday, Dec. 6, at the Shubert Theatre in the Theater District.

item.title: Siena: The Art of Bronze Fills the Frick Through January 18
item.description: Nearly forty Sienese bronzes, including works by Donatello, are on view at the Frick Collection, 1 East 70th Street, through January 18, 2027.

item.title: Iris van Herpen: Sculpting the Senses at the Brooklyn Museum Through December 6
item.description: More than 140 haute couture works share the galleries at the Brooklyn Museum, 200 Eastern Parkway, in the designer's North American debut.

item.title: Mezzo-Soprano Rihab Chaieb Sings Songs From Arabic Poetry at Carnegie
item.description: Wednesday, November 18 at 7:30 PM in Weill Recital Hall at Carnegie Hall, with pianist Ammiel Bushakevitz.

item.title: Seven Guitars Begins Previews at Lincoln Center Theater Tonight
item.description: Previews begin Thursday, November 5 at the Mitzi E. Newhouse Theater, with opening night on Monday, November 23.

item.title: Sonya Yoncheva Stars in Cherubini's Medea at the Met Opera
item.description: Wednesday, November 4 at 7:30 PM at the Metropolitan Opera House, Lincoln Center, with performances through November 21.

item.title: Stevie Wonder Brings 'Songs in the Key of Life' to the Garden
item.description: Stevie Wonder marks 50 years of his landmark double album with a Madison Square Garden show on Thursday, Nov. 19.

item.title: Sting Settles In for Eight Nights at Brooklyn Paramount
item.description: Sting brings his stripped-down STING 3.0 trio to Downtown Brooklyn for eight shows between Nov. 11 and Nov. 21.

item.title: Janáček's Jenůfa Arrives at the Met Opera with Grigorian and Stemme
item.description: Six performances from November 16 to December 4 at the Metropolitan Opera, Lincoln Center, in a new Claus Guth production.
